items.title: Logspace-uniform logarithmic-depth approximation of substochastic matrix powers and BPL inclusion
items.author: Kuan Cheng; Yichuan Wang
items.source_version: CCC2024, LIPIcs volume300 article32, 2024-07-15, official PDF pp.32:1-32:14; editable author-text transcription
items.difficulty_reason: The authors introduce an iteration whose error is controlled by squared approximation errors at nearby powers and linearly weighted errors at lower powers. Coupling this with multiplicative approximate counting and a precision-versus-exponent recursion yields a nonroutine uniform logarithmic-depth matrix-powering algorithm.
